cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(import_leaf_probe C CXX ASM_MASM)
add_executable(reference_host host.cpp)
add_library(import_leaf_helper SHARED helper.asm)
set_target_properties(import_leaf_helper PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME import_leaf_helper)
target_link_options(import_leaf_helper PRIVATE /INCREMENTAL:NO /OPT:NOICF /NXCOMPAT /CETCOMPAT:NO /NODEFAULTLIB /DYNAMICBASE:NO /EXPORT:helper_leaf /ENTRY:DllMain /MANIFEST:NO)
add_executable(import_leaf_exe fixture.c fixture.asm)
target_compile_options(import_leaf_exe PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:/W4;/WX;/O2;/GS->)
target_link_options(import_leaf_exe PRIVATE /INCREMENTAL:NO /OPT:NOICF /NXCOMPAT /CETCOMPAT:NO /NODEFAULTLIB /EXPORT:vm_probe /EXPORT:reference_slot,DATA /ENTRY:fixture_entry /SUBSYSTEM:CONSOLE)
target_link_libraries(import_leaf_exe PRIVATE import_leaf_helper kernel32.lib)
add_library(import_leaf_dll SHARED fixture.c fixture.asm)
target_compile_options(import_leaf_dll PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:/W4;/WX;/O2;/GS->)
target_compile_definitions(import_leaf_dll PRIVATE BUILD_DLL=1)
target_link_options(import_leaf_dll PRIVATE /INCREMENTAL:NO /OPT:NOICF /NXCOMPAT /CETCOMPAT:NO /NODEFAULTLIB /EXPORT:vm_probe /EXPORT:reference_slot,DATA /ENTRY:DllMain /MANIFEST:NO)
target_link_libraries(import_leaf_dll PRIVATE import_leaf_helper kernel32.lib)
